## Checklist

- [ ] Title is a Conventional Commits header (`type(scope): summary`, ≤100 chars, no trailing period)
- [ ] No `TOG-`/`PAP-` IDs, private URLs, or secrets in title, body, commits, or branch name
- [ ] Squash merge (do not pass `commit_title`/`commit_message` to the merge API)
- [ ] Every review finding addressed or replied to with why it does not apply
